grid=[[1]*30 for _ in range(30)]
ys=[0,8,16]; xs=[0,9,19]
colors=[[2,4,3],[3,6,9],[9,4,5]]
for i,y in enumerate(ys):
  for j,x in enumerate(xs):
    for r in range(y+1,y+7):
      for c in range(x+1,x+7): grid[r][c]=8
    for r in range(y+3,y+5):
      for c in range(x+3,x+5): grid[r][c]=colors[i][j]
# sequence / key row from the input
for c,v in zip([1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15,17],[2,4,3,9,5,4,6,3,9]): grid[28][c]=v
# Directed connectors in sequence order: A->B->C->F->I->H->E->D->G

def right(y,x,color):
  for r in range(y+3,y+5):
    for c in [x+5,x+6]: grid[r][c]=color
    for c in [x+9+1,x+9+2]: grid[r][c]=color

def down(y,x,color,dy):
  for c in range(x+3,x+5):
    for r in [y+5,y+6]: grid[r][c]=color
    for r in [y+dy+1,y+dy+2]: grid[r][c]=color

def left(y,x,color,dx):
  for r in range(y+3,y+5):
    for c in [x+1,x+2]: grid[r][c]=color
    for c in [x+dx+5,x+dx+6]: grid[r][c]=color

def up(y,x,color,dy):
  for c in range(x+3,x+5):
    for r in [y+1,y+2]: grid[r][c]=color
    for r in [y+dy+5,y+dy+6]: grid[r][c]=color
# right A->B (x delta 9): right() target start uses x+9
right(0,0,2)
right(0,9,4)
# down C->F, delta 8 rows
down(0,19,3,8)
down(8,19,9,8)
# left I->H; source x19 target x9 delta -10
left(16,19,5,-10)
# up H->E; source y16 target y8 delta -8
up(16,9,4,-8)
# left E->D
left(8,9,6,-9)
# down D->G
down(8,0,3,8)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
